Hi Monica,

Thanks again for offering to run a short on-site demo for our platform team during KubeCon Singapore. We have a short 25 minute slot on Thursday the 19th between 10:30–11:00 (local SGT). Can you confirm that works for Redwood?

I attached the full attendee itinerary; Tom will join in person. If that slot doesn't work, we also have a standby window at 16:00–16:30.

Also — quick note: our docket shows the time as "10:30 SGT" but one of our engineers forwarded a screenshot where the calendar shows 02:30 (looks like PST/UTC-8). Not sure if that's on your team's invites or a calendar conversion issue — can we double-check so nobody misses it?

Thanks,
Naomi

Hi Naomi — great to hear, and congrats on the packed schedule for the conference.

Confirmed we can do the 10:30–11:00 SGT slot on Nov 19. I just sent a Google Calendar invite titled "Redwood — KubeCon on-site demo (25m)" to the attendee list; payload includes the demo room number.

Quick note: Vivek (SE) and I are both traveling from the US and have our phones set to home timezones; we saw the same PST display in our calendars until we toggled the event to show "Event time zone: Singapore (SGT)". I updated the invite to explicitly set the event time zone to Asia/Singapore and attached an .ics to the thread for folks who import.

I also attached the Redwood-side micro-demo plan in the calendar description. If any of your team needs a walkthrough of the plan before showtime, Vivek can hop on a 15-minute call.

I'll add Tom's confirmation once I see it.

Best,

Hi all — noted. Monica — I'll be in Singapore the 18th–20th and can be there early.

Action items from our side:
- I'll arrive to the demo room by 10:15 SGT and run the AV/network check.
- I'll bring a hotspot + HDMI adapter and a prebuilt Docker image of the demo in case conference network is flaky.
- I'll post a Jitsi fallback link in the calendar description and include the dial-in number.

Naomi/Tom — can you confirm whether conference rooms will allow outbound connections on port 443? If not, we'll switch to the local image.

Monica — small FYI: my calendar showed the invite earlier as 10:30 PST (02:30 SGT) because my laptop was still set to US Pacific DST rules. I changed the event timezone to Asia/Singapore too. Our travel team sometimes sets hotel clocks manually which causes a mismatch between phone and room clock — I screenshot the hotel clock and attached it.

Regards,

Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

If neither AV nor conference networking works, Vivek's plan to bring a local image and hotspot is perfect. We'll ship the demo artifacts and the brief runbook to your shared Drive link (HubSpot: HS-70321) by EOD.
